params.body:
A **Pull requests** section on `/portal/werkbank`, and the pull requests that wait for the owner in `owner/state` (the phone's watch screen and the app).

The list comes from Elixir's new `controlPulls` report (elixir `elixir:control-pulls`, every ten minutes; a separate pull request). `App\Support\Pulls` maps each repository to the project that links it and gives each pull request one state the owner acts on:

- **ready to merge**: not a draft, no conflict, checks passed (or none ran);
- **look**: a conflict with its base, failed checks, or a draft, with the first of those named;
- **running**: checks not finished, shown but not counted as waiting.

Each row says whom a review was asked of, or *no review asked on GitHub* when the gateway's App opened it and no request reached anyone: exactly the pull requests that sit in none of the owner's lists there. When the report is older than 30 minutes the section says so, and repositories Elixir could not read are named.

On the phone, `OwnerState::waiting()` gains kind `pull` for ready and look; the workbench screen leaves them out (it is about admitting, and a pull request without a project would otherwise read as the policy line), the watch screen counts them.

From the owner-workflow audit in abovebeyond `docs/owner-workflow-audit/`, fix 7. Without a report nothing changes on the page.

Tests: `PullsTest` (5 new). Pint and PHPStan pass; the full suite passes except `BuildStampTest`, which fails only when run from a git worktree.
params.title: Pull requests that wait for the owner, on the workbench page and the phone
